Brøndbyernes Idrætsforening, usually abbreviated to Brøndby IF, is a Danish professional football club based in Brøndbyvester. Brøndby is the professional football section of Brøndbyernes Idrætsforening, which was founded on 3 December 1964 by a merger of the football clubs Brøndbyøster Idrætsforening and Brøndbyvester Idrætsforening. The club's first team, which plays in the Danish Superliga, plays its home games at Brøndby Stadium in the clubs colors of blue and yellow.
